issues.description: The problem statement/UML declares ExcellenceLand.excellencyLevel as type double, but the solution implements it as int (and the constructor/getter use int). This mismatch will confuse students about the expected type and cause constructor/signature tests to fail if they follow the UML specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of excellencyLevel consistent with the UML/problem statement by changing it to double in the implementation and constructor signature (and update the getter to return double). Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to use int if that was intended. Ensure the constructor parameter order and types match the UML: (double excellencyLevel, boolean excellentEnough, List<Ride> rides).
